dedupe_keys.name: magma open source mobile packet core network platform linux foundation

description: Magma is an open-source software platform that gives network operators an open and extendable mobile core network, described on its site as a next-generation packet core for mobile network operators, internet service providers, cable operators and satellite providers. Its stated aims are cellular service without vendor lock-in, more automated network management, federation between existing operators and new infrastructure providers to expand rural coverage, and added capacity through Wi-Fi and CBRS spectrum. Coverage: generic software, aimed in particular at rural and underserved connectivity. Format and access: source code in the magma GitHub organisation, with deployment and configuration documentation and a wiki; free. Licence: BSD 3-Clause, read from the repository licence file. Caveats: the current pace of development was not checked, and the software was not built or run for this record; hardware and partner offerings named on the site were not read. Simulation uses: testbeds and digital twins of mobile core networks, including federated rural networks, to study resilience, capacity and recovery of mobile service. Related records: Open5GS (platform-open5gs-open-source-5g-lte-core) and free5GC (platform-free5gc-open-source-5g-core) are alternative open cores.
